subject: Future Tech
title: Environmental Risks of Nanotech
description: One-minute skill: Environmental Risks of Nanotech.

hook.text: Nanoparticles are so small they cross biological barriers: skin, lungs, blood-brain.

buildup.text: Nano-silver from consumer products washes into rivers.

discovery.text: Studies show nanoparticles accumulate in fish, worms, and plants.

climax.text: The EU leads in nano-regulation, requiring labeling and safety testing.

punchline.text: The smaller the material, the bigger the regulatory gap.

quiz.question: Why are nanoparticles an environmental concern?
options: They're too expensive to dispose of
They cross biological barriers and accumulate in ecosystems
